gaps.sentence: The cottage sits ___ the crossroads, visible from all four roads.
gaps.explanation: 'At the crossroads' — 'at' for a point where roads meet.'

gaps.sentence: I'm in no ___ — take your time deciding.
The surgeons operated ___ the light of head-torches when the power failed.
gaps.explanation: 'By the light of' = using the light from something.

gaps.sentence: We finished the report ___ time for the meeting.
gaps.explanation: 'in time for' = early enough; 'on time' = punctual.

gaps.sentence: The proposal was rejected ___ a single vote.
gaps.explanation: 'by a single vote / by two goals' — the margin takes 'by'.

gaps.sentence: She's ___ charge of the whole marketing department.
The negotiations broke down ___ the very brink of success.
gaps.explanation: 'on the brink of' = on the point of.

gaps.sentence: The two reports differ ___ several important respects.
